name: @aibytes/web
description: The aibytes.io daily-edition app. Vite + React, a static build for GitHub Pages, reading the edition JSON in content/.

scripts.test:rules: if command -v firebase >/dev/null && command -v java >/dev/null; then firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-aibytes "node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules.test.js src/accountSaves.test.js src/subscriberStore.test.js"; else echo "test:rules skipped: needs the Firebase CLI and Java"; fi
